AgentCompass v0.7.0 changes what the score levels mean, ships its reference data with the version, and keeps the settings earlier releases wrote for you. It builds on v0.6.8.

- **Level 3 is the panel's best, not the anchor model.** The level scale of each facet is now the calibration panel's weakest (1), median (2) and best (3) measured value. Until v0.6.8 level 3 was the anchor model `claude-opus-5-5` on every facet, which was wrong wherever another panel model measures higher (faithfulness, design, image recognition, responsiveness). The anchor remains only the zero point of the scores. A model above the panel's best has a level above 3, shown as its number instead of `3+`. A definition change alone moves no routing: the fit of every bundle is the same under both definitions on the same data.
- **Manual scores are converted, not re-entered.** `user-scores.json` moves to schema 3. The shipped maintainer scores and your own local scores are converted by one declared rule (`references/level-3-conversion.json`): a level of 2 or lower is unchanged, a level above 2 keeps its position relative to the anchor, so each score stands for the same value as before. Your local file is converted when it is read and written in the new schema the next time you save a score.
- **Reference data ships with the version.** Model scores, prices and window capacities are written once per release and read from the installed version. The between-release public data channel is removed; nothing is fetched at run time. The update removes what the channel left under `~/.agent-compass` (`public-data/`, `public-data-config.json`).
- **Settings written by earlier releases are kept.** `accounts-override.json` (account choices, working-directory rules that the v0.5.0 matcher agrees with), host-rules overlays, the providers you removed in a launcher, the Usage Float autostart choice and `user-scores.json` are carried into the current shape when read, each by a tested step. A dispatch decision recorded under an older task profile is refused on its own while new dispatches proceed. `agentcompass doctor` lists only what needs you, and every line prints a fix that says what it discards.
- **Reference data rebuilt on 2026-11-18.** The calibration panel adds `gpt-6-sol` and `grok-4.6` and drops `mimo-v2.6-pro` and `qwen3.8-max`. arena.ai boards: the Agent board is the page of 2026-11-13, the Alignment board the capture of 2026-11-09. `claude-fable-5-2` is now measured on coding. The Codex window capacity follows the community source of 2026-11-16 (USD 615.5 to 693.0). The `qwen3-max` row is removed: its source publishes no figure for it.
- **A manual responsiveness level bounds the other efforts.** A manual level sets the High effort; responsiveness at higher efforts is then at most that value and at lower efforts at least it, the mirror of the rule ability facets already had.

Not in this release: the arena.ai Alignment page of 2026-11-15, which the page marks preliminary. Five community sources of window capacity are 39 to 71 days old and are kept as they are. Not verified on a live account: a launch of the GPT-6.2 models through Codex or Pi, and their fast mode, which stays off.

The Windows tray installer is unsigned; Windows SmartScreen may warn on first launch. See [packaging/SIGNING.md](https://github.com/akiiwa-games/AgentCompass/blob/v0.7.0/packaging/SIGNING.md).

Status: alpha. Accounts come from discovery on your machine; choose which ones take part in the tray.
